name: It Takes Guts
summary: Argo Brinewhistle asks you for beast entrails and Rotflesh mushrooms as bait for a long-necked creature he has seen near the islands. He hopes the catch will make others believe his tale.

sections.title: Argo's Bait
sections.body: Argo Brinewhistle says he has seen a long-necked monster around the islands while out on his boat. He wants you to gather beast entrails and Rotflesh mushrooms for bait. The mushrooms grow in a cave by Windstead, and Argo hopes to catch the creature.

faq.answer: Argo Brinewhistle is a fisherman who says he has seen a long-necked monster around the islands.

faq.q: What does Argo want for bait?
faq.answer: Argo asks you to bring him beast entrails and Rotflesh mushrooms.
Rotflesh mushrooms grow in a cave by Windstead.

faq.q: Why does Argo need the bait?
faq.answer: Argo wants bait so he can catch the long-necked creature he says he has seen near the islands.
Argo says people dismiss his story because they see him as a drunkard fisherman.

attribution: In-game quest text: It Takes Guts
